sources.evidence_extract: Manufacturer 'SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL' sheet from Shenzhen Shouhan Technology Co., Ltd (title block on physical page 1 confirms manufacturer identity and exact part number CYA1265-100UH; retrieved via LCSC's datasheet.lcsc.com PDF host). Electrical Characteristics table (physical page 3), row CYA1265-101M (Product Code CYA 1265 101 M decodes to L0=100uH, tolerance code M=+/-20%, matching this part): L0=100.00uH +/-20% at 0A, Rdc Typ=155.00mOhm / Max=185.00mOhm at 25C, Heat Rating Current Idc=4.50A, Saturation Current Isat=8.50A, test freq 100kHz/1.0V. Notes (physical page 4) define Idc as the DC current causing an approximate 40C temperature rise and Isat as the DC current causing an approximate 30% L0 drop, and state the rated current is whichever of the two is lower -- this datasheet does not separately label an 'Irms' rating.
